 A new week means a new tournament. For some of those involved on the ATP Tour, at this late stage in the season, it's off to Stockholm, where on Monday, one of the more interesting matches sees Daniel Vallejo take on Ugo Humbert. This is a match between two out-of-form competitors, both of whom will be looking to redeem themselves with a promising run of performances in the Swedish capital. 
 At anything bigger than -225, we should be betting on Ugo Humbert to get the job done against Daniel Vallejo. Sure, the French player has not quite been at his best of late, but he's shown more than his opponent, while he's returning to a venue where he's previously thrived, reaching the final of this event in 2025.

 Our Adolfo Daniel Vallejo vs Ugo Humbert Prediction
 Neither player arrives in hot form, and on that basis, anything can happen. However, we cannot ignore two clear facts, two clear facts that the market may not be considering enough. Firstly, Ugo Humbert was hugely suited by the conditions at this event a year ago, so returning to Stockholm could help him to deliver his best form. 
 Secondly, Vallejo has struggled to be anywhere near his best in recent matches against top-50 players, losing each of his three such matches in recent weeks.
